title: CodesSkill
description: codes.skill@1: one skill, rule, MCP server, command or hook in the OpenVibe.Codes hub (the Compute plan §5, E6). KIND says what it is: a skill is a SKILL.md folder the agent tools load, a rule is text for the tools' AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files, an mcp record is one MCP server definition, and command/hook are a slash command and a hook. SLUG is the folder name (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens) and is stable within one owner. VERSION is the newest record in codes.skill-version@1; BODY is that version's content. AUDIENCE is the four sharing audiences of openvibe-sdk/share: private (the owner only), people (the owner and the members listed in codes_skill_members), link (anyone with the link, not in the gallery) and public (the gallery, search and agents). A private, people or link record is never in the gallery. OFFICIAL marks OpenVibe's own skills. TOOLS names the harnesses the skill is written for; an empty list means every tool the Node knows. The body is untrusted text: the page renders it through the markup gate (escape first, then a small Markdown subset), never as HTML.

owner_subject.description: The person who owns the record.

slug.description: The stable folder name (SKILL.md lives in a folder with this name).

audience.description: The sharing audience, the same four openvibe-sdk/share uses.

official.description: True for OpenVibe's own records; the gallery shows them beside community ones.

version.description: The newest coded_skill_versions row for this record.

body.description: The skill's SKILL.md body (or the rule/command/hook/MCP text), untrusted Markdown.
